group_assessment.weighting: A targeted narrative review of pediatric parkinsonism (PubMed search limited to 10 years to December 2025; no formal appraisal, stated as a limitation). The CSF/imaging table content is a secondary synthesis of cited reviews. The article discloses that generative-AI tools were used for language editing. WWOX does not appear anywhere in the text.

entries.proposition: The review is a targeted narrative review with a PubMed search restricted to the last ten years, and states that it is not a systematic review.
entries.snippet: The literature search was not conducted as a formal systematic review, and therefore some relevant studies may not have been captured and selection bias cannot be excluded.

entries.proposition: Generative AI was used for language editing.
entries.snippet: ChatGPT (OpenAI) and Perplexity (OpenAI) were used for assistance with language editing and improvement of clarity during the preparation of the manuscript.

entries.proposition: Infancy table: in DAT deficiency the CSF HVA/5-HIAA ratio is markedly increased; in VMAT2 deficiency urinary monoamine metabolites are elevated while free monoamines are low.
entries.snippet: in VMAT2 deficiency, urinary monoamine metabolites are elevated while free monoamines are low

entries.proposition: Infancy table: TH deficiency gives markedly reduced CSF HVA, and BH4-pathway disorders give combined low HVA and 5-HIAA with an abnormal pterin profile.
entries.snippet: Markedly reduced HVA in CSF with variable changes in other monoamines and pterins in TH deficiency; combined low HVA and 5-HIAA with abnormal CSF pterin profile

entries.proposition: Dopamine transporter functional imaging is typically normal in monoamine synthesis defects and abnormal in nigrostriatal denervation.
entries.snippet: Dopaminergic functional imaging (such Dopamine Transporter [DaT]-SPECT [DaTSCAN] or dopaminergic PET) is typically normal and can aid in distinguishing disorders with preserved nigrostriatal function

entries.proposition: Levodopa and standard dopaminergic therapy are largely ineffective in DAT deficiency.
entries.snippet: Levodopa and standard dopaminergic therapy are largely ineffective in DAT deficiency

entries.proposition: The review lists epilepsy, developmental delay and neurodevelopmental disorders among the associations of pediatric parkinsonism.
entries.snippet: It is commonly associated with additional neurological manifestations, including dystonia, global developmental delay, epilepsy, neurodevelopmental disorders, and oculogyric crises, among others (1).

entries.proposition: The proposed work-up begins with CSF monoamines, pterins and urine studies in infants and young children.
entries.snippet: Metabolic and CSF studies are fundamental in infants and young children, since several etiologies are treatable (32–34).

entries.proposition: The diagnostic algorithm is a figure; its caption is the only text, and the figure was not inspected as an image in this reading.
entries.snippet: Proposed diagnostic algorithm for pediatric parkinsonism. This diagnostic algorithm summarizes a practical age-stratified approach to the etiological evaluation of pediatric parkinsonism.
